title: dbprint statistics.yaml v1
description: Per-table column statistics. See SPEC.md section 2.2.

CatalogOnlyColumns.description: columns.* under catalog_only: sql_type/classification only, nothing a query would have measured. See SPEC.md section 2.2.15.

CatalogOnlyRowCount.description: row_count/row_count_method require a query; catalog_only states none was issued for this object at all. See SPEC.md section 2.2.15.

Merging.description: SPEC 2.2.19: a merging engine combines rows sharing `key` only when it merges parts.

spelling_of.description: The listed value this entry is another spelling of; absent on the canonical member and on every ungrouped value. See SPEC.md section 2.2.4.

Geometry.description: SPEC 2.2.4: a spatial column's kinds, reference systems, coordinate dimensions, empty and invalid counts.

Extent.description: SPEC 2.2.4: the X/Y box over a spatial column's non-empty values, rounded outward.

Dimension.description: SPEC 2.2.4: the fewest and most elements among a vector column's non-null values.

Norm.description: SPEC 2.2.4: the smallest and largest Euclidean norm among a vector column's non-zero values.

Types.description: SPEC 2.2.4: how many values hold each engine type name; a count, never a literal.

parts.description: SPEC 2.2.18: the profiled parts of this column, keyed by canonical path relative to it.

Part.description: SPEC 2.2.18: one part's block - the column block for its classification, over its occurrences, less the column-only fields.

parts.description: SPEC 2.2.18: the profiled parts of this column, keyed by canonical path relative to it.

BoundsUnlessDropped.description: range and percentiles are cell values, so a column declaring redacted: drop emits neither; every other column of these classifications emits both. See SPEC.md section 2.2.9.

ValueListUnlessProse.description: A text column whose inferred.looks_like is prose emits no values, no values_coverage and no distribution, since that field is derived from the list; every other text column emits all three. See SPEC.md section 2.2.3.

SensitivityOnlyInferred.description: The SPEC 2.2.3 row where `inferred.sensitivity` (plus the classification-independent `candidate_key`/`candidate_key_exception`, SPEC 4.2) is the only detection a classification may carry (boolean, json, temporal). The container stays optional; `Inferred`'s minProperties keeps an empty one unrepresentable.

SensitivityAndEpochUnitInferred.description: The SPEC 2.2.3 row where `inferred.sensitivity` and `inferred.epoch_unit` (plus the classification-independent `candidate_key`/`candidate_key_exception`, SPEC 4.2) are the only detection a classification may carry (numeric only - SPEC 4.5's bounds rule). The container stays optional; `Inferred`'s minProperties keeps an empty one unrepresentable.

NothingWithheldWhenRedacted.description: A column declaring any redacted primitive publishes its count profile and nothing else computed from its values. See SPEC.md section 2.2.9.

TableUnmeasured.description: SPEC 2.2.1: the table-level twin, restricted to the blocks whose absence is otherwise a positive claim. `grain` is excluded (required, and `search.exhausted` already carries the partial case) and so is `depends_on` (its absence already means the producer could not ask).

Unmeasured.description: SPEC 2.2.4 / 2.2.1: names the fields (or table-level blocks) this run attempted and could not obtain. Every named entry MUST be absent from the same object - which no schema keyword can express against a name list, so the conformance validator carries that half. Its presence relaxes the classification branch's own required list to the five fields REQUIRED on every classification, since which of the rest it excuses is that same name list. Omitted entirely when nothing failed.
